message: Last winter, we got hit with a snowstorm that kept most of us indoors for days. Instead of fretting about the weather, I decided to embrace it — I made a big pot of soup, gathered up all my favorite blankets, and declared a family movie marathon. We even set up a little ‘snow day’ contest for who could build the best blanket fort! It turned a potentially dreary situation into a cozy family memory. Who else has turned a stormy day into a fun indoor adventure?
